pages.text: $(item)Brass$() is the second tier of Create metal, made by mixing copper and zinc in a heated basin. Brass casings and parts open up funnels with filters, tunnels, mechanical arms and more.

pages.title: Brass Ingot
pages.text: Copper plus zinc in a mixer over a heated burner. See $(l:create_basics/processing)Processing$(/l).

A $(item)Precision Mechanism$() is made by $(thing)sequenced assembly$(): one item goes through a chain of steps on a belt, repeated several times. It becomes an $(item)incomplete$() item in between. The steps use deployers and a press.

pages.title: Precision Mechanism
pages.text: Needed for many advanced machines in several mods. The recipe has a small chance of giving other items. Check JEI for the loop.

pages.title: Mechanical Crafter
pages.text: Arrange several in a grid and connect their paths to craft any recipe, even ones too big for the mixer. Fill every slot, then it crafts.

Mechanical crafters need rotation. Use a wrench to arrange paths, and slot covers to leave holes in the grid.$(br2)The $(item)Mechanical Crafter$() works with packages too, see $(l:create_basics/packages)Logistics$(/l).
